text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—A sparkle just like that... 
Maya had seen it once before.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, aren't you done yet? 
We were all supposed to go to the movies 
today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Sorry, just one more set...! 
Hah, whew... I'll be done in a sec!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My mom's coming to my next race. 
She took time off and is flying in from 
back home. So—...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Her race wasn't some huge, prestigious 
event. 
Maya and her friends were probably the 
loudest ones cheering.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (Yet, that girl—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry about that. You guys came all 
the way to cheer for me... 
...and I totally lost~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Mother
text_block_list.text: You looked so cool.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You were truly so cool. Mom's so glad she 
got to see your race! 
It was amazing, and I could tell. I can 
tell how hard you run every single day."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: B-But...! Today of all days, I—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You gave it everything you had! Yeah, 
anyone watching would say the same! 
Because you were so cool! Giving it your 
all right until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Mother's Voice, Mayano's Voice
text_block_list.text:
—Because you were sparkling, and so, so 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Mayano-san! Good morning! 
Pearl-san and I actually just came up with 
a brand-new bit!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A new bit?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed! After studying comedy shows and 
gag manga, we came up with... 
a Manzai Guitar Solo! Pearl-san's guitar 
and I will banter back and forth!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of the boke and the tsukkomi, 
it's the guitar & tsukkomi! 
Truly uncharted, groundbreaking 
territory—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Show me... Show Maya too! 
What you two came up with—what you two are 
putting everything into!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
......Very well, of course. Let's do this, 
Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Aha, so you just can't remember the 
seasoning used for mapo tofu.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I see, I see, OK Shiraoki! 
The indispensable seasoning for mapo tofu 
is, in other words, toban—"
(Struuuum...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oooohhh...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what?! That was the part where 
you're supposed to laugh!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... Well, for you two, 
Fukukitaru-san, that was just way too well 
put-together. 
Like, kind of classy, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Guh-kkh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Right? ...Didn't you two want a third 
member before Maya showed up 
because having three people means more 
sounds and more laughs?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, you should let Maya 
help make the bits too! 
Not just be the 'cool in-charge'!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Huh? ...Mayano-san?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"—Come on, let Maya in on it! 
Maya will think super hard and brainstorm 
tons of ideas too!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... A comedic band featuring a 
wizard and her familiars, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! We're clumsy, we're wacky, 
but we're wizards who'll definitely cast a 
spell of smiles on everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Always giving our all. Always plotting to 
make someone laugh. 
We're weird, weird, super weird... but 
everyone can't help but smile!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ? What is it, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Doing this means changing what you 
originally wanted to do, you know. 
...Are you sure? You—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No, it hasn't changed. Maya wants to do 
this too. 
Because I can still do what I wanted to 
do!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Sure, you two are wacky, 
and it's totally, completely different 
from the band Maya looked up to."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Even when Maya was pouting, and even when 
I told you we should split up our roles. 
You two were always, always—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Being serious. Giving your all. —Trying to 
do something super cool!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do it! Let's give it our all! 
I can still put my body on the line, no 
problem!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, Mayano. 
—We're looking forward to working with you 
from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Ah, Maya-chan! Morning~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Morning~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. You're even more hyped up than 
usual today! 
What's up, did something good happen?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It did!! 
Ehehe, and while we're at it, I have a 
favor to ask you two."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"—When the Holy Hoof Festival starts, 
come watch Maya and the others on stage 
too!"
